author: Spoookeh
body:
Hey guys, hopefully I'm releasing this just in time. I'd like this to become a tournament map for the upcoming CTW tourney. It was made entirely by myself with a lot of feedback from DaFrozenBlaze, thanks!

Author(s):

SpookehSkeletons

Contributors:

DaFrozenBlaze

Resepignev (Flo)


Images: http://imgur.com/a/cCW4B

XML: Soon

Map Download: Soon


Features:

  • Approx. 5s spawn timer
  • 2 wools either side, orange must capture pink and purple while blue must capture yellow and lime.
  • Extra supplies on side islands.
  • Lots of iron in spawn.
  • Water in spawn.
  • Gapple spawner at mid and you therefore don't spawn with any.
  • Spawn kit includes a bow with 2 stacks of 64 arrows and a diamond pickaxe with no enchants (also full leather)
  • Diamond chest plates, power 1 bows and lots of stacks of gapples in wool rooms.
  • Quite a few bedrock walls stopping tunnelers but 1/2 of them (2 out of 4) can be circle jumped on one side.

-Spookz

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! :D Those islands were something I was debating removing or not. I wanted the map to be as ground contested as skybridge contested and that's why I made middle very big (for pvp space), added a gapple spawner, and implemented those 2 islands to make it a bit easier to cross over.
